description: This file defines the OrderService class in C#, which implements the IOrderService interface. It provides functionality to create orders from shopping baskets, interacting with repositories for baskets, catalog items, and orders, and utilizing auxiliary components like a URI composer.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IOrderService responsible for creating orders based on shopping baskets, managing associated repositories, and composing order details.

methods.name: CreateOrderAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that creates an order from a basket ID and shipping address by fetching basket details, validating data, retrieving catalog items, constructing order items, and saving the order.
